Name: Garden Paths
Author: CNCooper
Description:
New paths / floors.

Designed to provide a 'kitchen garden' aesthetic.
Most changes are adpated from the original Stardew Valley tilesets, so they fit well within the game.


[b]Changes[/b]
Straw Floor -> Grass / Lawn
Gravel path -> Brick-edged gravel path (common in many of the UK kitchen gardens found in heritage houses)
Wood Path -> New wood path


[b]Todo[/b]
Cobblestone Path -> New cobblestone path with edging
Seasonal changes for Seasonal Immersion mod.


[b]Installation
[/b]Place file in:
<Stardew Valley Directory>\Content\TerrainFeatures

Make a backup of the original 'Flooring,xnb' first
